# Source-weighted Jensen cubic identity and sharp variance failure

27 October 2026. Exact next-mechanism interface and an exact obstruction. This does not assert a new entropy sign.

Let τ=EX, D=X−τ, ED=0, N=W3⊗id and T_A physical partial transpose. Define the actual source-weighted Kadison variance

W=Tr[X(N((NX)^2)−(N²X)^2)]≥0.

Self-adjointness of N and N²X=τ+D/4 give the exact identity

16W=3Tr(τD²)−TrD³−2Tr[(T_A D)^3].               (1)

Indeed TrX N((NX)^2)=Tr(NX)^3, ND=−T_A D/2, and Trτ(ND)^2=TrτD²/4. The latter follows by swapping the two physical block indices in the trace sum; it does not require reference blocks to commute. The remaining cubic expansion is ordinary cyclic trace algebra.

If X≤2τ then both τ+D and τ−D are valid positive sources with the same marginal. Applying (1) to both signs yields the rigorous but potentially non-strict bound

|TrD³+2Tr[(T_A D)^3]|≤3Tr(τD²).

A conjectured strengthening of coefficient3 to3/2 is FALSE, even at peak3/2, and no uniform positive lower bound W≥c TrτD² with c>0 is possible on this region.

## Exact sharp witness

On C3⊗C3 let F be swap, τ=I9 and

D=(3F−I)/4,
X=I+D=(3/2)P_sym.

Then ED=0, −I≤D≤I, and X≤(3/2)τ. The spectra are

D: 1/2 with multiplicity6, −1 with multiplicity3,
T_A D: 2 with multiplicity1, −1/4 with multiplicity8.

Thus

TrD²=9/2,
TrD³=−9/4,
Tr[(T_A D)^3]=63/8,
TrD³+2Tr[(T_A D)^3]=27/2=3TrD².

Therefore W=0 exactly despite X≠τ. The full actual logarithmic Jensen gap is also zero on the source support: NX=(9/8)(I−P_Φ), and N²X acts as9/8 on the symmetric support of X. Consequently

Δ(X)=J(X)=9log(32/27)>0.

This is the already-paid rigid symmetric boundary family, not an entropy counterexample. It demonstrates the specific complementarity needed by a future payment argument: the Jensen variance can vanish where the generic logarithmic surrogate J is already positive. A useful stronger lower bound must therefore depend on the same source's negative surrogate defect or equivalent joint spectral information, rather than only on TrτD².

# The single global-bound variance payment does not close the whole target

27 October 2026. Exact physical counterexample to a sufficient-certificate route, not to VALUE or to the received Jensen lower bound itself.

The received actual_channel_jensen_variance_receiver.md gives, for Y=NX≤MI and C=NY,

logC−NlogY≥∫_0^∞(C+sI)^−1 V(C+sI)^−1 ds/(M+s),
V=N(Y²)−C².

This is a true lower bound. The proposed stronger conclusion that J plus twice its source-weighted payment is always nonnegative is false, even when the smallest valid global M=||Y|| is used.

Take the faithful physical3/reference3 isotropic source

X=8P_Φ+(1/8)(I−P_Φ), τ=EX=I9.

Put a=8,b=1/8,c=(a+3)/4=11/4,d=(b+3)/4=25/32. The output Y has eigenvalue c on the antisymmetric sector and b on the symmetric sector, so M=c is optimal. C=N²X has eigenvalue c on P_Φ and d on its complement. The variance V vanishes on P_Φ and has eigenvalue

v=(3/16)(c−b)²

on the complement. Therefore twice the actual source-weighted lower payment is exactly

L=16b v ∫_0^∞ ds/[(M+s)(d+s)²]
 =3b(c−b)² [log(d/c)−1+c/d]/(d−c)²
 =(2/3)[log(25/88)+63/25].

The generic logarithmic contrast is

J=8log(128/121)+log(128/625).

Exact rational logarithm intervals certify

J+L<−29/100.

The actual deficit remains positive and is independently covered by the full operator-valued isotropic theorem:

Δ=8log8−(1/2)log(1/8)−(33/2)log(11/4)>0.

The omitted higher resolvent terms and/or the finer actual Stinespring complement contain essential additional payment in this source. No failure of the exact Jensen identity or of its positive lower bound is implied. The example does not rule out this sufficient certificate on a smaller relative-peak region such as peak2; it only rules out an unrestricted promotion of the single global-bound variance truncation.
